description: This file implements a set of 'reasoners'—components that evaluate the relevance of responses to questions using multiple criteria and voting. It includes functions for analyzing questions, voting on literal answer correctness, intent alignment, scope appropriateness, and synthesizing these votes into a final verdict. Additionally, it features a full orchestrator that manages the entire multi-jury process and a quick evaluation version for faster assessments.

methods.name: dict analyze_question( question: str, model: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Analyzes a question to extract primary intent, sub-questions, and expected answer type to guide relevance evaluation.

methods.name: dict vote_literal_relevance( question: str, response: str, question_analysis: Dict, model: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Evaluates whether the response directly and literally answers the question, providing a score and reasoning.

methods.name: dict vote_intent_relevance( question: str, response: str, question_analysis: Dict, model: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Assesses if the response addresses the underlying user intent and goal, providing a score and reasoning.

methods.name: dict vote_scope_relevance( question: str, response: str, question_analysis: Dict, model: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Determines if the response is appropriately scoped—neither too narrow nor too broad—and addresses sub-questions.

methods.name: dict synthesize_relevance_verdict( question: str, response: str, literal_vote: Dict, intent_vote: Dict, scope_vote: Dict, model: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Synthesizes the votes from individual jurors into a final verdict, considering disagreement and confidence levels.

methods.name: dict evaluate_relevance_full( question: str, response: str, model: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Coordinates the entire multi-jury relevance evaluation process, from question analysis to juror voting and verdict synthesis.

methods.name: dict evaluate_relevance_quick( question: str, response: str, model: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Performs a faster, single-reasoner relevance assessment suitable for quick evaluations.
